name: indo_afro_sunrise
character: An Indo-Afro groove inside a rainforest canopy: the groove and the ambience carry the piece, so the gate keeps every melodic row and adds the immersive and environment rows, and it relaxes nothing.
why: the piece has a figure (bansuri) and a full rhythm section, so `melodic` is the closest shipped type; this profile is the project's own document, and it starts with no row changed
